name: Gojou Saki
source:
On her way home with Makoto, they end up becoming lost. Inquisitive and very much an "actions over words" kind of girl, Saki is an optimist. She was raised being addressed as "Hanahime-san" because of a family tradition, but is unaware of what that title actually means. In spite of her aversion towards cherry blossoms, for some reason, she also feels drawn to them.

Translation of the [URL=http://www.mead-soft.net/sakuragatari/character.php]official website's[/URL] character profile.
